trust_decision.summary: Whether a session-authenticated POST to attributes/editField must carry a valid CSRF token (body _Token or X-CSRF-Token header); decided by BetterSecurityComponent::_validateCsrf during Security startup, and switched off for editField by listing it in Security->unlockedActions in AttributesController::beforeFilter.

landing_point.why: The summary says attribute modification via CSRF; editField is the AJAX single-field save on MispAttribute, and its CSRF exemption sits in the same file's beforeFilter at line 56.

fix_sites.module_kind: controller beforeFilter security configuration (fix.diff:35 removes the unlockedActions entry, fix.diff:27 adds editField to _csrfTokenHeaderOnly)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 route: saveFreeText's CSRF exemption applies only when Plugin.CustomAuth_enable is set, a separate SSO/header-auth deployment mode, and the route creates attributes in bulk rather than editing a field, so it looks like a different feature that was exempted on purpose.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Two legitimate editField callers must keep working: the Overmind to_ids toggle posts a form-encoded body via fetch() with the token only in X-CSRF-Token, and the legacy inline Cake forms post a serialised form whose _Token fields-hash does not survive the AJAX submit. Just deleting editField from unlockedActions re-enables _validatePost and blackholes both; the fix keeps the CSRF check and drops only validatePost.

O6_input_shapes: CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header with a form-encoded body (Overmind fetch)
CSRF token in the body _Token[key] of a serialised Cake form (legacy inline edit forms, app/View/Attributes/ajax/attributeEditCommentForm.ctp:2)
body with fields at top level rather than under Attribute[...] (editField re-wraps it, app/Controller/AttributesController.php:1217-1222)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /events/saveFreeText/{id} creates attributes (or proposals) on an event with csrfCheck switched off whenever Plugin.CustomAuth_enable is set
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only under the CustomAuth deployment mode; bulk attribute creation rather than field edit; looks like a deliberate exemption for header-auth SSO
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different controller file (app/Controller/EventsController.php, sink at app/Controller/EventsController.php:6747-6767), same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add Objects editField (app/Controller/ObjectsController.php:585) to the non-REST unlockedActions list next to revise_object/get_row, the object-level twin of this flaw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Objects editField is driven by the same misp.js inline-edit code path (app/webroot/js/misp.js:681) and would hit the same field-hash blackhole, so a maintainer would plausibly unlock it the same way

O8b_injection_room.sibling: toggleCorrelation exempted via unlockedActions for its AJAX toggle
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is another AJAX single-attribute toggle that saves MispAttribute and has no rendered form hash

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a header-only list where an entry is matched case-insensitively or by prefix, or a csrfCheck=false keyed on _isRest() rather than __carriesApiKey()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AppController already carries comments about exactly this REST-vs-API-key confusion (app/Controller/AppController.php:273-280)

O9_family: CSRF / missing anti-forgery check on a state-changing action (exemption list)

O10_build.project_tests: app/Test/BetterSecurityComponentTest.php (security component unit tests); no editField-specific test found

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete 'editField' from unlockedActions, which re-enables _validatePost and blackholes the Overmind header-token toggle and the legacy inline forms.

out_of_scope_notes: ObjectsController revise_object (unlocked for non-REST, app/Controller/ObjectsController.php:26) writes request data into the session key object_being_created (app/Controller/ObjectsController.php:86-89); not an attribute save, not pursued.
UiBeta postAttributeFieldToggle posts to editField with no visible token (app/View/Themed/UiBeta/Elements/eventattribute.ctp:1666-1675); after the fix it may break unless a token is added elsewhere.
